references.text: Warning that the Kohathites must not touch the holy things, or they will die—the same context of protecting the Levites from death when approaching the Most Holy Place.
Continuation of the instructions that the Kohathites must not see the holy things being covered, for then they will die—a direct continuation of the theme of preserving their lives.
The Levites must not approach the vessels of the sanctuary or the altar, so that neither they nor the priests will die—the same theme of protecting the Levites from death at the sanctuary.
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord—an example of the consequence of approaching the holy in the wrong way.
Aaron and his sons must wear the proper garments when entering the tent of meeting, so that they do not incur guilt and die—the theme of the priests' responsibility to protect the Levites.
The Levites are given to Aaron to serve him and perform service at the tabernacle—Aaron's responsibility to assign tasks to the Levites.
The Kohathites were given no carts because they were to carry the holy things on their shoulders—a specific assignment of duties to the Kohathites.
